ITM-001.name: Government Badge
ITM-001.spend_effect: Identifies you as federal agent. Some doors open. Some eyes narrow.

ITM-002.name: W-90 Handgun
ITM-002.spend_effect: A last-resort tool. It changes the tone of every conversation.

ITM-003.name: Encrypted Codec
ITM-003.spend_effect: Call your handler. Receive mission updates. Or get static.

ITM-004.name: Chen's Dropped Wallet
ITM-004.spend_effect: A photo, a receipt, a name that doesn’t match the face.

ITM-005.name: Subway Token
ITM-005.spend_effect: Access to a service stairwell that isn’t on the map.

ITM-006.name: Rusty Key
ITM-006.spend_effect: Opens a basement latch that smells like old paper.

ITM-007.name: Jesuit Bible
ITM-007.spend_effect: Margin notes, coded initials, a place-name: Kaniksu.

ITM-008.name: Pinkerton Coin
ITM-008.spend_effect: A private insignia. Not official. Not harmless.

ITM-009.name: Russian Matryoshka
ITM-009.spend_effect: A nested message: someone wanted you to open it slowly.

ITM-011.name: Panda Plushie
ITM-011.spend_effect: A soft decoy with a hard label stitched inside.

ITM-012.name: Lab Coat
ITM-012.spend_effect: You look like you belong where you shouldn’t.

ITM-013.name: ID Badge (Dr. Hoffman)
ITM-013.spend_effect: A barcode that passes. For now.
